title: Two Seats, One Screen
logline: Two friends find their recliners at IPIC just before the house lights go down.
status: Draft for Val's review (#501). Not approved, not committed as media, not published.

Theo.appearance: the browser fixture's third account (bob), as committed

constraints: Auditorium only: no lounge floral wall, no street frontage or signage in shot.
No new canon, no feature claims, no brands, no OpenCoven marks, no implied IPIC partnership.
Fictional characters: Maya and Theo are not anyone real.

From behind the pair toward the idle screen.
From near the screen back toward the pair.
The host starts the film: the house lights dim and the screen lights up.
